text:
Ingrid: Quick announcement — adoption finalized today! Were officially parents 38991d Also 3-year Redwood anniversary this week and they snuck a promotion to Sr. PM in there too. Surreal day.
Ben: WOW congrats Ingrid!! All of that in one day?? Legend. :tada: :heart:
Tom: Huge congrats!! 389 Such great news. Office breakfast to celebrate?
Ingrid: Thinking breakfast Friday 9:30 in the kitchen. Small things, coffee, pastries. What should I bring? Vote: :croissant: croissants, :bagel: bagels, :muffin: muffins, :pancakes: mini pancakes
Noor: :croissant: but can we also have decaf?
Asha: :bagel: if someone brings shmear i will love them forever. Also congrats 60d
Maya: :muffin: for the kids who visit! Also congratulations x100.
Ben: I can grab coffee + orange juice. What time exactly?
Ingrid: 9:30. If youre remote but want to send a note, DM me and Ill paste in the card. No gifts please, but feel free to bring a story.
Tom: RSVP yes. Ill bring a box of bagels in case croissants sell out.
celebration-bot: Reminder set for Friday 09:30 389 "Ingrid celebration: adoption + anniversary + promotion" (reminder id: 7731)
Noor: Congrats again!! well sing an off-key version of happy anniversary.
Ingrid: Thanks everyone. Cant wait to celebrate and share the tiny human pics.
